name: us-tech-memo-no-pii
text:
Build Pipeline Migration -- Internal Engineering Memo

This memo summarizes the plan to migrate our continuous integration
pipeline from the legacy job runner to the new containerized build
farm over the coming quarter.

The current pipeline suffers from long queue times during peak hours
and lacks reproducible build environments, which has led to a class of
failures that only reproduce on specific runner hosts. The new
architecture standardizes every build inside a pinned container image,
eliminating host-specific drift entirely.

Rollout will proceed in three stages: first, mirroring a subset of
jobs onto the new farm while leaving the legacy runner authoritative;
second, flipping the default for new jobs while keeping the legacy
path available as a fallback; third, decommissioning the legacy runner
once error rates on the new farm have remained flat for two full
release cycles.

No changes to source control workflows, branch protection rules, or
release tagging conventions are required as part of this migration.
Engineers should not need to change how they open or merge pull
requests at any point during the rollout.
